title: Air and Missile Defense (AMD) Crewmember
raw_text:
10-14P. MOS 14P-- Air and Missile Defense (AMD) Crewmember, CMF 14 (Effective 202510)
    a. Major duties. The air and missile defense crewmember supervises, operates or serves as a member
of a lightweight, highly mobile, air defense weapons systems. Duties for MOS 14P at each level of skill
are:
        (1) MOSC 14P1O. Prepares, operates and fires the Avenger weapon system and Man Portable Air
Defense System (MANPADS) in degraded operations as required while assigned to the Avenger System.
Establishes and maintains radio and wire communications. Assists in maintaining range card. Performs
target engagement evaluation. Applies infrared (IR) techniques to detect and engage targets Resupplies
ammunition and prepares systems for firing. Perform emergency procedures for weapon systems.
Maintains sight alignment on systems. Operates and maintains system carriers.
        (2) MOSC 14P2O. Performs duties in preceding skill level, supervises and assists the preparation
and firing of the Avenger weapons systems. Collects and consolidates intelligence information. Processes
special and periodic reports. Prepares and maintains range card. Designates fighting positions. Transmits
alert status and readiness changes over secured network. Receives air early warning and tracks
incoming targets over the Pony PCU.
        (3) MOSC 14P3O. Performs duties in preceding skill level, supervises the Avenger team/squad.
Prepares for and supervises section movement. Supervises radio and wire communications. Plans for
and supervises ammunition resupply. Deploys section to provide air defense coverage. Coordinates
operations and intelligence data.. Supervise dissemination of air and ground early warning information to
subordinate fire units over the Pony Portable Computer Unit (PCU). Assists update of Operation Order
(OPORD), range cards and overlays. Employs weapon systems. Supervises Preventive Maintenance
Checks and Services (PMCS).
        (4) MOSC 14P4O. Performs duties in preceding skill level, supervises Avenger platoon operations.
Performs or supervises ADA operations and intelligence duties. Assists platoon leader in planning,
management and training activities of subordinate sections. Conducts platoon reconnaissance, selection
and occupation of position (RSOP). Coordinates platoon and section logistical activities.
    b. Physical demands rating and qualifications for initial award of MOS. AMD crewmembers must
possess the following qualifications:
        (1) A physical demands rating of significant (Gray).
        (2) A physical profile of 111121.
        (3) Minimum height of 64 inches.
        (4) Distance vision correctable to 20/20 without multi-focal lenses.
        (5) Normal color vision.
        (6) Qualifying scores.
            (a) A minimum score of 87 in aptitude area OF (Effective 202406).
            (b) A minimum OPAT score of Standing Long Jump (LJ) – 140 cm, Seated Power Throw (PT)
– 400 cm, Strength Deadlift (SD) – 140 lbs., and Interval Aerobic Run (IR) – 0040 shuttles in Physical
Demand Category “Significant” (Gray).
        (7) A security eligibility of SECRET is required for the initial award and to maintain the MOS. An
interim Secret security access granted by Central Clearance Facility (CCF) meets this requirement.
        (8) Formal training (completion of MOS 14P course conducted under the auspices of the U.S.
Army ADA School (USAADASCH) mandatory after 1 October 2016.
        (9) A U.S. citizen.
    c. Reclassification: Must meet the above qualifications and all prerequisites IAW AR 614-200 Chapter
3-19 and AR 40-501 Chapter 3. Must be in the grade of SPC (non-promotable) or below unless they
have served within a CMF 14 MOS for a minimum of 12 months at skill level 1 or 2, 18 months at skill
level 3 or 24 months at skill level 4.
        (1) Active Component: Soldiers that do not meet the above qualifications must submit a
determination packet to Cdr, OCADA, ATTN: ATSA-ADA, Ft Sill, OK 73501
    d. Additional skill identifiers. (Note: Refer to table 12-8 (Listing of universal ASI’s associated with all
enlisted MOS)).
        (1) K7--Avenger Master Gunner.
        (2) R2—Stryker Leader (personnel only).
        (3) Q6--Protection Cell Operations (skill level 4 through 6 for personnel only) (Effective 202410).
        (4) S5 – M-SHORAD Master Gunner.
        (5) T3--Ground-Base Midcourse Defense (GMD) System (personnel only).
    e. Physical requirements and standards of grade. Physical requirements and SG relating to each skill
level are listed in the following tables:
        (1) Table 10-14P-1. Physical requirements.
        (2) Table 10-14P-2. Standards of grade TOE/TMOE.
        (3) Table 10-14P-3. Standards of grade TDA.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
